target.title: fix(qqbot): add timeout to speech transcription requests
target.body:
Related: #95865

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where QQBot voice-message handling could wait indefinitely when the configured STT endpoint accepts the transcription request but never responds.

## Why This Change Was Made

QQBot already bounds adjacent API and media requests; this change passes the STT request deadline into `fetchWithSsrFGuard` while preserving the existing response body caps.

## User Impact

Voice-message processing now fails within a bounded timeout instead of blocking the QQBot inbound attachment path on a stalled STT provider request.

## Evidence

- `TMPDIR=/media/vdc/0668001470/tmp/openclaw-task-tmp node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/qqbot/src/engine/utils/stt.test.ts` - passed; `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 7 passed (7)`.
- `TMPDIR=/media/vdc/0668001470/tmp/openclaw-task-tmp node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/qqbot/src/engine/utils/stt.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/utils/stt.test.ts` - passed; exit 0.
- `git diff --check` - passed; exit 0.
- Mutation check: temporarily removing `timeoutMs: sttCfg.timeoutMs` made the focused Vitest fail with `expected undefined to be 30000` and `Expected STT timeout rejection, got pending`; restoring the patch returned the test to green.

## Real behavior proof

Behavior addressed: QQBot STT transcription requests now have a deadline when the server accepts the request but never responds.

Real environment tested: local Linux Node source checkout; real `node:http` loopback server that accepts the connection and never responds, driving the real exported `transcribeAudio` function.

Exact steps or command run after this patch: `TMPDIR=/media/vdc/0668001470/tmp/openclaw-task-tmp node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/qqbot/src/engine/utils/stt.test.ts`

Evidence after fix: the focused test uses a Promise.race negative control to show a no-timeout request remains pending against the loopback server; with `timeoutMs: 50`, `transcribeAudio` rejects with an AbortError/TimeoutError after the server receives the STT request.

Observed result after fix: `Test Files 1 passed (1)` and `Tests 7 passed (7)`.

What was not tested: live QQ platform traffic or a live third-party STT provider; the hang is reproduced with a real local HTTP server, not the real third-party service.
